summary: Moved deterministic orbit capture component configuration to run after Initialize()/initialize_sp_funcs(), so native Initialize() can no longer overwrite bAlwaysPersistRenderingState=false. Added targeted tests that mimic the native initialization overwrite and verify both deterministic and render-history-enabled setup behavior.
work_completed: Updated examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py so setup_camera_sensor() initializes capture components before applying configure_deterministic_capture_component().
Preserved camera-cut behavior in capture_scene(); disable_render_history still marks bCameraCutThisFrame before CaptureScene().
Extended tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py fake capture components so Initialize() resets render-history state like USpSceneCaptureComponent2D::Initialize().
Added tests covering post-initialize deterministic capture configuration and render-history-enabled preservation.
Ran the two new ordering tests via unittest with local stubs for missing numpy/yacs/spear dependencies; both passed.

findings.message: python -m pytest tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py could not run because pytest is not installed.
python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation could not run fully because the available Python environments are missing numpy.
Live Unreal render validation was not run in this environment; no Unreal runtime was exercised.
No C++ changes were required; the fix is in Python ordering after the existing native Initialize() behavior.
Docs were not updated because this ordering fix did not change user-facing wording or workflow semantics.

follow_up_recommendations: Inspector should review the setup ordering and confirm live orbit render behavior in an Unreal-capable environment.
